library(Rose)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)
require(tikzDevice)

f1 <- function(df) {
  gg <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y)) +
    geom_point()
  assign("ggp", plotly::ggplotly(gg), envir = parent.frame())
  # ggp
  df # NOT returning a plot
}
res1 <- f1(df)
ggp # Let knit handle the plot
myplotly(ggplot())
